newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets 4-week T-bill auction on Aug 6.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets 4-week T-bill auction on Aug 6.

text.p: The Slovak central bank (NBS) said on Monday it would auction an unspecified tranche of four-week Finance Ministry treasury bills on August 6.
In the last successful auction of four-week T-bills on May 7, the average yield was 14.21 percent.
The Finance Ministry on July 9 sold a 2.42 billion crown tranche of five-week T-bills at an average yield of 16.048 percent.
The ministry does not set an amount on offer at state securities auctions or set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.
It uses T-bills and state bonds as the main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which widened to 17.790 billion crowns as of July 8, 1997, from 7.177 billion in the January-May period.
